Achtung! Bitte Upgrade: Attention! Your software version is outdated. Kindly update it promptly
AchtungText:
1. The update will take 1-10 minutes depending on the network conditions in the store.
2. Updates can only be performed with an internet connection.
3. After the update is successful, it is recommended to restart the application. The way to restart the application is to press the Windows key (four squares) on the keyboard, then click the red cross to close the application, and then reopen it.
4. If the update fails, please contact us as soon as possible for manual update.

aboutUsBusinessContent: The Aaden system was designed with input from numerous actual on-site staff with many years of experience in the restaurant industry. We have carefully understood the real needs of the catering industry practitioners, from the boss to each employee, and launched the Aaden intelligent cloud digital catering integrated solution. Scan code ordering, delivery, website reservation, table management, flexible deployment and efficient design, change the management mode of the catering industry from top to bottom. The Aaden system is also the last system you need, as flexible deployment options[1] provide the possibility to "grow" the software, from a small cafe to a giant cafeteria with thousands of seats, the Aaden system is like a fireplace Always be by your side.

DineOnlinePayingConfirmTitle: Guest is paying on their phone
DineOnlinePayingConfirmHint: The guest at table {table} is paying {amount} € online right now. If you check out at the till now, the guest may pay twice and need a manual refund. Check out anyway?
DineOnlinePaidConfirmHint: The guest at table {table} has already paid {amount} € online. The cloud is checking out this table, usually within a few seconds. Checking out again at the till charges twice. Check out anyway?
DineOnlineReviewConfirmTitle: Paid online, but the amount no longer matches
DineOnlineReviewConfirmHint: The guest at table {table} has already paid online, but the cloud could not check out this table (usually because the bill changed after payment). At checkout the keypad shows "Online payment" and fills in what the guest paid online (up to {amount} € left; only the bill amount if the bill is smaller; the tip the guest paid is added too). Settle the rest with the guest in person. Once it is all recorded, the payment is closed in Portal automatically. Do not charge the full amount again. Go to checkout now?
DineOnlinePayOver: The online payment is more than the guest paid online (another till may have just recorded it), or the table is no longer pending. Close checkout, open it again and use the amount shown on the keypad.
DineOnlinePayNotAllowed: "Online payment" can't be used for this table now: it is no longer pending, or it is not this payment's method. Close checkout and open it again.
DineAddDishesOrderClosed: This order has already been checked out, dishes can no longer be added
DineAddDishesTableBusy: This table is being checked out, please try again shortly
